name: Insaneless
source:
I can't figure it out... Who turns on the light in the empty apartment?

I have only one way to find out... Break the wall to them.

[From [url=https://halkind.itch.io/insaneless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我一直想不通……是誰在空無一人的公寓裡開燈？

只有一個辦法能弄清楚……砸穿隔在我和他們之間的牆。

［取自[url=https://halkind.itch.io/insaneless]itch.io[/url]］
